title: 实验室安全（四）：化学品危害
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/13_Chemical Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 4.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/13_Chemical Hazards Lab Safety Video Part 4/src.py

points.K7: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
points.K15: 象形图各代表什么危害

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室货架前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of lab shelves stocked with reagent bottles and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全系列第四课：化学品的危害。
overlay: 认识化学品的危害：SDS与标签

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜里拿出一瓶陌生试剂，准备直接打开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes an unfamiliar reagent bottle from a cabinet and is about to open it at the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到一瓶没用过的试剂，就想开工。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着瓶上的红色菱形图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at the red diamond GHS pictogram on the bottle label.
shots.narration: 小研问：它有什么危险，你知道吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣在货架前对镜讲解，身旁浮现火焰、压力表、两瓶混合图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks in front of the shelves with three icons beside it: a flame, a pressure gauge, and two bottles pouring together.
shots.narration: 实验室很多化学品都有潜在危险。

shots.scene: 两瓶液体混合处冒出黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers pouring into one flask with a yellow warning triangle popping above it. No people.
shots.narration: 高温、高压或互相混合时尤其危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣一手举空白文件夹，一手举试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank binder in one paw and a labeled reagent bottle with a blank label in the other.
shots.narration: 识别危害，主要靠两件工具。

shots.scene: 一份空白说明书的前两页特写，上面有四个象形图
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the first two pages of a blank safety data sheet with four red diamond pictograms and blank text lines. No people.
shots.narration: 每种化学品都必须有一份SDS。

shots.scene: 工厂图标连向一份空白文件
shots.prompt_en: A small factory icon connected by an arrow to a blank document. No people.
shots.narration: 它通常由生产商提供。

shots.scene: 旧文件夹变成新文件夹
shots.prompt_en: An old worn binder transforms into a new clean binder with a sparkle effect, both with blank covers. No people.
shots.narration: 它以前叫MSDS。

shots.scene: 空白文件四周浮现性质、危害、防护图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document surrounded by three icons: a flask for properties, a warning triangle for hazards, and a shield for precautions. No people.
shots.narration: 性质、危害、防范措施，一站全查到。

shots.scene: 书架上一排按字母区间分好的空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A shelf of binders with blank spines sorted by letter ranges, shown as simple tabs without text. No people.
shots.narration: 要知道本实验室的SDS放在哪里。

shots.scene: 老周在柜旁翻阅文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The older man, wearing glasses, flips through a binder next to a cabinet.
shots.narration: 第一次用某种化学品前，先读SDS。

shots.scene: 地球图标连接一份统一格式的文件
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon connected by arrows to one standard blank document. No people.
shots.narration: GHS是全球化学品统一分类标签制度。

shots.scene: 文件展开成十六格
shots.prompt_en: A blank document unfolding into a grid of sixteen blank tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 按新制度，SDS一律分成16部分。

shots.section_title: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
shots.scene: 第一格高亮：瓶子和工厂图标
shots.prompt_en: The first blank tile lights up, showing a bottle icon and a small factory icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第1部分：名称、描述和生产商联系方式。
overlay: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险

shots.section_title: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
shots.scene: 第二格高亮：菱形象形图和空白警示条
shots.prompt_en: The second tile lights up, showing a red diamond GHS pictogram and a blank warning strip. No people.
shots.narration: 第2部分：信号词、警示语和安全符号。

shots.section_title: 第1–3部分：是什么、有何危险
shots.scene: 第三格高亮：成分饼图
shots.prompt_en: The third tile lights up, showing a simple pie chart of ingredients. No people.
shots.narration: 第3部分：成分清单。

shots.scene: 第四格高亮：急救十字和冲洗图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth tile lights up, showing a green first aid cross and a water rinsing icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第4部分：接触后需要怎样处理。

shots.scene: 第五格高亮：灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: The fifth tile lights up, showing a fire extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第5部分：消防措施。

shots.scene: 第六格高亮：围堵溢洒的图标
shots.prompt_en: The sixth tile lights up, showing a small spill puddle surrounded by an absorbent ring. No people.
shots.narration: 第6部分：怎么围堵和清理泄漏。

shots.scene: 第七格高亮：试剂柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The seventh tile lights up, showing a closed storage cabinet icon and a hand holding a bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 第7部分：操作处置和储存要求。

shots.scene: 第八格高亮：护目镜、手套和一枚法规印章图标
shots.prompt_en: The eighth tile lights up, showing goggles, gloves and a legal seal icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第8部分：美国监管机构的接触限值。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、呼吸器图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of goggles, gloves and a respirator with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 还有个人防护装备的建议。

shots.scene: 第九格高亮：温度计、水滴、火苗图标
shots.prompt_en: The ninth tile lights up, showing a thermometer, a water droplet, a nose icon and a small flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第9部分：外观、气味、pH、闪点等。

shots.scene: 第十格高亮：两瓶相遇被红叉隔开
shots.prompt_en: The tenth tile lights up, showing two bottles separated by a red X between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第10部分：怎样避免危险反应。

shots.scene: 第十一格高亮：人体轮廓和三条箭头
shots.prompt_en: The eleventh tile lights up, showing a human outline with three arrows toward the nose, skin and mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 第11部分：接触途径、症状和影响。

shots.scene: 第十二到十五格依次高亮：树叶、垃圾桶、卡车、天平
shots.prompt_en: Tiles twelve to fifteen light up one by one, showing a leaf, a waste bin, a truck and a scale of justice icon. No people.
shots.narration: 后面是生态、废弃、运输、法规信息。

shots.scene: 四格旁出现一枚法规印章和问号
shots.prompt_en: A legal seal icon with a question mark next to the four tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 在美国这四部分不强制，但要熟悉。

shots.scene: 第十六格高亮：日历图标和一个四色菱形
shots.prompt_en: The sixteenth tile lights up, showing a calendar icon and a four-color hazard diamond with numbers. No people.
shots.narration: 第16部分：编制日期和最近修订日期。

shots.scene: 欣欣在货架前对镜讲解
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera in front of the lab shelves.
shots.narration: SDS里有大量安全使用的信息。

shots.scene: 试剂柜里贴满空白标签的各种试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A reagent cabinet full of bottles of different sizes, each with a blank label and small pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 了解化学品，还可以读它的标签。

shots.scene: 放大的空白标签，上方色块高亮
shots.prompt_en: A large blank chemical label; the top blocks light up one by one: product name and signal word. No people.
shots.narration: 标签有产品名称和信号词。

shots.scene: 空白标签上信号词色块旁出现两个选项
shots.prompt_en: On the blank label, two option blocks appear beside the signal word block. No people.
shots.narration: 信号词，比如“危险”或“小心”。

shots.scene: 标签中部色块和三个象形图高亮
shots.prompt_en: The middle blocks of the blank label light up together with three red diamond pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 物理健康环境危险说明、防范说明、象形图。

shots.scene: 标签下方两个色块高亮：急救和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Two more blocks at the bottom of the blank label light up: a first aid cross and a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有急救说明和供应商联系信息。

shots.scene: 一个GHS象形图放大：红菱形边框、白底、黑图形
shots.prompt_en: One large GHS hazard pictogram: a white diamond with a thick red border and a black flame symbol inside. No people.
shots.narration: 象形图：白底黑符号，红色菱形框。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 白底上并排出现四个象形图：健康危害、火焰、感叹号、气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Four GHS pictograms appear side by side on white: health hazard, flame, exclamation mark and gas cylinder. No people.
shots.narration: 每个象形图代表一类危害。
overlay: 象形图各代表什么危害

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 健康危害和火焰两个象形图高亮
shots.prompt_en: The health hazard and flame pictograms light up. No people.
shots.narration: 人形是健康危害，火焰是易燃。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 感叹号和气瓶两个象形图高亮
shots.prompt_en: The exclamation mark and gas cylinder pictograms light up. No people.
shots.narration: 感叹号是毒性有害，气瓶是压缩气体。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 又出现四个象形图：腐蚀、爆炸弹、圆圈上方火焰、环境
shots.prompt_en: Four more GHS pictograms join the row: corrosion, exploding bomb, flame over circle and environment. No people.
shots.narration: 腐蚀是伤皮肤眼睛，爆炸弹是不稳定物。

shots.section_title: 象形图各代表什么危害
shots.scene: 八个象形图排成两行，环境象形图高亮
shots.prompt_en: All eight pictograms in two rows; the environment pictogram lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 还有环境危害和急性毒性。

shots.scene: 圆圈上方火焰象形图放大
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram with a black flame over a circle symbol, enlarged. No people.
shots.narration: 圆圈上方火焰，表示氧化性。

shots.scene: 氧化剂瓶放出氧气箭头，旁边纸张火苗变大
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bottle releasing small oxygen arrows toward a nearby burning paper whose flame grows bigger. No people.
shots.narration: 氧化剂靠释放氧气引发燃烧。

shots.scene: 阿杰举着瓶子对照打开的说明书，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the reagent bottle next to an open blank binder and nods confidently.
shots.narration: 看SDS、读标签，就能识别危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一张带右箭头的空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a blank card with a right arrow on it.
shots.narration: 下一课，学习安全操作化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现文件夹和试剂瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank binder and a labeled bottle.
shots.narration: SDS放哪要知道，首次使用先读。

shots.scene: 十六格文件图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document icon with sixteen small tiles. No people.
shots.narration: 十六部分，急救泄漏防护都在里面。

shots.scene: 空白标签和八个小象形图
shots.prompt_en: A blank label icon next to eight small GHS hazard pictograms in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 标签七要素，象形图各有含义。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的试剂柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy closed chemical cabinet.
shots.narration: 先识危害再动手，下次见！
